dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible dorsal mass from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior termination at the bottom of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight localized indentation on the left lateral margin approximately one-third down the visible length; right margin displays a continuous convex curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey with subtle lavender-blue undertones; median intensity indicates a sub-adult or light-grey juvenile phase rather than mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density spatial frequency of fine, dark-pixel specks distributed across the anterior dorsal surface, becoming more sparse toward the posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient transition between the light-toned dorsal canvas and the dark, low-reflectance perimeter of the water interface.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, centrally aligned, high-contrast circular blowhole visible at the superior end of the dorsal plane.
